title: Tech Note: Getting Started With 4D Open for Java

historical_commentary.text: This introductory note walks Java programmers through the basics of 4D Open for Java and applet-based interaction with 4D Server, at a time (2000) when Java applets were a mainstream way to deliver interactive client functionality through a browser. Both halves of this note's technology stack — 4D Open and Java applets — are now defunct: 4D Open was discontinued long ago, and browsers dropped applet/plugin support years ago, so this note today has historical value only, illustrating early-2000s thinking about cross-platform, programmatic access to 4D Server.
related_updates: Java applets are no longer supported by any modern web browser
4D Open (including its Java variant) has been discontinued; modern external access to 4D Server data uses 4D's REST/ORDA data server instead
